thread:
vika: Quick heads-up: onboarding sampleapps (node + python) exhibit different behaviors when REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug. Node shows request-id mismatch after retry; Python sometimes logs an old request-id after await. believe root cause is two parts: deferred telemetry init path at debug level + inconsistent place where retry middleware stamps ids.

dave: can you paste concise repro + versions? we'll make it a small triage item.

vika: repro (node): set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug, start examples/node, hit /chat with client that retries once. log snippet: incoming rid=A, retry sets rid=B, span.start uses A, SDK later reconciles -> B.

vika: repro (py): with uvicorn and concurrency, logging filter reads contextvar set early; a later retry updates headers but not the contextvar, so logs show old id while span has new id.

sdk-bot: created issue #5010: "preserve request-id across deferred init and async boundaries" assigned to @dave. suggested fixes: stash existing header during init, provide set_request_id helper that updates header+contextvar, add telemetry.metric telemetry.requestid.reconciled.

dave: plan: 1) small Node patch: on init prefer req.headers[x-request-id] if present and stash on req._rw_orig_rid; 2) Python: add set_request_id helper and update sampleapp middleware to call it; 3) add CI integration tests that run sampleapps at debug and assert log request-id == span attribute.

qa: scheduling staging run after patches and will monitor telemetry.requestid.reconciled in hosted to ensure fix is low-risk.

vika: workaround for now: init telemetry early (require('redwood-telemetry').init({forceSync:true})) or set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info for onboarding scripts. both not ideal. thanks team :thumbsup:
